ontologies.title: DATEX II EnergyInfrastructure (EV-charging)
ontologies.description: Hub-curated OWL/SKOS ontology for DATEX II's EnergyInfrastructure EV-charging (IRVE) model: entities, attributes and enumeration code values.

ontologies.title: W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DID) v1.0 Vocabulary
ontologies.description: RDF vocabulary for describing DID documents and services, from the W3C Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0 Recommendation. Used by the Gaia-X ICAM (Identity, Credential & Access Management) semantic model for participant identity.

ontologies.title: Eona-X ODRL Profile
ontologies.description: The supported subset of W3C ODRL 2.2 the Eona-X dataspace connectors bind and enforce, extended with three credential-claim constraint leftOperands.

ontologies.title: mobilityDCAT-AP SHACL range shapes
ontologies.description: Range/type SHACL shapes for mobilityDCAT-AP properties. Published under CC BY 4.0.

ontologies.title: NeTEx/Transmodel — EV Charging & Alternative-Fuel
ontologies.description: Hub-curated OWL/SKOS rendering of the NeTEx (CEN/TS 16614, Transmodel-based) vehicle-charging and alternative-fuel subset: charging/refuelling/battery equipment, recharging stations and points, and vehicle charging profiles.
